cats._note: Human-like cat-emoji replies to people who comment on the last watch_posts posts, ONCE per person (see minions/aggregator/cats.py). DISABLED until you set enabled=true AND replace every emoji id with a real premium cat-emoji id (get ids with the /emojis dump helper). tz_offset_hours is the persona's UTC offset (3 = Moscow) so hours match the legend. hours_* are [mean_hour, sigma, weight] Gaussian peaks; quiet_hours are near-silent. latency_* is the log-normal reaction delay after a comment; spacing_* is the heavy-tailed gap between cats (bursts then silence). skip_prob ignores a comment; silent_day_prob mutes a whole day; double_prob sends a rare second cat. recency_half_life_sec fades a just-used cat; mood_phi/mood_sigma is the day-to-day AR(1) mood; a cat's tags (sleepy/bodry/winter/spring/summer/autumn/newyear) re-weight it by daypart/season. NOTE: comments are matched as replies to the post message id -- this fits a group target; for a channel with a linked discussion, point the account at the discussion group.

_note: Emoji are premium {id, fallback} entries (render from a user account with Telegram Premium). Replace an entry with a plain glyph string like "🔥" to use a non-premium emoji. Add more love/announce variants freely.
